dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: That would be the huge ice-mining machine in town. I heard it was brought in from the Energy Commission. No idea what's wrong with it, but it breaks down all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: We rough fellows can't make heads or tails of complicated machines, so the whole mess of managing that hunk of metal ended up falling on Sobolev.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: And, because of that machine, some rumors have started going around town. A while back, it even drew in a reporter, saying they wanted to investigate some kind of corruption...

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: Ah! I'm not saying I believe those rumors! No, no, what I mean is, there shouldn't be any rumors like that in the first place!
